newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taiyo Life to buy Y240 bln in yen, foreign bonds.
newsitem.headline: Taiyo Life to buy Y240 bln in yen, foreign bonds.

text.p: Taiyo Mutual Life Insurance Co plans to invest about 200 billion yen in yen bonds and 40 billion yen in foreign bonds in fiscal year 1997/98, which started on April 1, a company official said on Tuesday.
He added that the company plans to reduce lending by 50 billion yen and to cut slightly its long-term stock holdings.
The company held 62.9 billion yen worth of bad loans at the end of March, versus total assets of 6.7 trillion yen, he said.
The levels at which unrealised profits on its stock holdings would fall to zero are 10,600 in the Nikkei stock average and 810 in the TOPIX index, he added.
